integrity.proof_status: analytic proof with supplementary numerical checks

scientific_limitations: Infinite nearest-neighbor lattice only; no finite-size boundary or external forcing.
Reset-site set finite; iid Pareto intervals independent of the starting reset site.
Result concerns time-ensemble occupation and stationary moments, not experimental sample realizations.
General renewal theory and a classical Bessel Mellin integral may implicitly yield the theorem, even if no directly equivalent inspected statement was found.
title: Universal two-sided Pareto tails and the \(\alpha=3\) variance boundary for conditionally reset quantum walks
